steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: FAC decontamination force is in position. Chief, could you...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Oh... Is it already over? I knew we could count on the Chief! Sorry, we were late.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph, that worked out just fine. You guys would just hold me back anyways. What do they call it, the division of neighbor? I'll fight the monsters, and you guys clean up after. It's all you're good for anyway.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Make sure you get the corners too, CLEANUP FORCE.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's "the division of labor," I taught you that last night.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Ahhhh shut up!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Pfft... Ahem! Well, Chief ${PlayerName}, please take care of the contamination analysis. I'll go check the civilians.
You walk over to Hecate.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: FAC has tested the composition, and the contamination wasn't an external invasion. It's exactly the same as the residue of BR-004, which started to proliferate under the influence of some stimulus.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The activity level is low, but this is indeed a sign of the ring becoming active.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Could the "Corpus"...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey... Don't make scary assumptions. The monsters from half a year ago were really fierce, but those ones just now turned to run as soon as they spotted me like EMP.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I've grown much stronger, but... I don't think I'm that intimidating yet.
The monsters formed from contaminations will inherit the Mania from the source, which is the obsession of someone deranged.

The Corruptors in the fourth ring were influenced by ground zero, Zoya, and were dominated by a reckless desire to destroy. The Corruptors just now, however, were easily frightened and even tried to run.
What woke them up must be very different from BR-004.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What would it be? Something that can penetrate the FAC anti-Mania force field and awaken what's left of the Black Ring... It must be a dangerous and powerful presence, but then how did it hide from the monitoring network?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The 9th Agency has provided the contact key of the agent, but he hasn't responded.
You look over to the anti-Mania base not far away, a ring monitoring network FAC built. It's meant to keep the contamination in and prevent the recurrence of disasters.
Looking down at the remaining filth, you find them turning gray in the Hypercube force field. But they keep trembling like they're struggling to escape or hide.
If the shackles are the power from "the other side"... will it give you hints? You reach out to touch the shackles, but before you manage, a strange sensation sweeps through you...
Without warning, something drums, and the world is submerged by a spurt of shadows. Or maybe you are falling into some gap, and the world around you is spinning.
You see palm prints, a drag mark, a path. It's something huge struggling and crawling through streets, walls, creeping on the roofs toward the northeast...

Your throat becomes parched, and the pungent smell of rust and scorched earth chokes you. Your skin is freezing and burning, and your eardrums are pierced by some terrible sound. You can hear a mournful wail...
<color=#dg1f1f><i>AHHHH... AHHHH...<color=#dg1f1f><i>

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief...?
The epileptic sight is only momentary, the darkness has receded, and everything is back to normal. The people around you look at you in astonishment. They did not see the sight you saw at all.
But the huge scorch marks that crawled across the crumbling city have been burned into your mind.
The call goes through, but it connects to the 9th Agency first, and an unfamiliar voice speaks out.
Hello there, Chief. I am "Rust," the inspector of the 9th Agency in the West District.
Forget it. You shouldn't have asked. It's not the first time you've learned that the 9th Agency is monitoring you.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hmm? Aren't you looking for me? I've risked exposure to bring you the long-awaited information.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: But you must have made an important discovery if you are contacting base in such a hurry. How about you do that first?
You recall the "illusion" you just had and look in the direction of the "trail"—northeast of the square, in the direction of the <color=#fb9259>DisSea Black Ring</color>.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I may have "sensed" something that triggered the mutation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It passed BR-004 and crawled toward DisSea. Or maybe it's the other way around, heading towards the square from DisSea.

You feel something from the shackles. It's a Corpus, the inheritance from Parma... this you are sure of. But it's impossible to tell if the sight is the past, the present, or just some kind of harbinger of the future.
When the vision fades, and the shackles regain their serenity, it's as if you were hallucinating. The FAC monitoring site never detected a Corpus-level contaminant source.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Should I follow the trace and investigate?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Easy, Chief, and don't be so honest. Your time is valuable, and you should hear the info I offer. We may not have your intuition, but our agents have some tricks up their sleeves.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Recently, an "old friend" has been very active on both sides of the Rust, throwing false leads around for the 9th Agency. However, only one is quite relevant to the direction you pointed out, and it is on the coast of DisSea.
An "old friend" of the 9th Agency, someone connected to the Black Ring... It's him?!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Yes. I've updated your database with the target location and relevant information. Get ready to go, Chief.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I have a hunch that the rats have set up a really big show. Please make sure you don't miss it.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I will go back immediately to get ready.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Please wait!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Regarding these civilians, Chief ${PlayerName}, can you please keep this under wraps? I mean... don't put it in the report.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Trespassing in the ring area to steal resources is a felony, and all those who are suspected will be sent to the detention center. If the people in charge knew about it, it would be the end for them.
An old man in a wheelchair trembles with fear and shivers as he hands over a rag in his hand, as if begging for forgiveness.
You then notice that it's Hypercube shards wrapped in the rag.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: They are not gangsters, nor WhiteSands smugglers, just some... ordinary people in Syndicate trying to live.

The civilians in front of you are old and frail, women and children, in rags, and the one standing in the front is just a skinny teenage boy. His eyes are filled with bewilderment, fear, and aimless hostility.

The West District chaos did not end following the destruction of the Black Ring and the fall of the gangs. Poverty and despair still shroud Syndicate, and these are the legacy of Mania and humanity. You are facing the victims who got it the worst.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: My duty is to investigate the mutation, not to enforce the law.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What about you?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Chief! The FAC's duty has always been to protect the city and its citizens from Mania. I'm going to confirm their mental state and send them home if they're not corrupted.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Thank you for your understanding!
He salutes you and clunks off with his bulky armor to attend to the civilians. You ignore Hella's snicker and return to the MBCC to make final preparations.
